build.buildCommand: cd customer && npm install && npm run build && cd ../owner && npm install && rm -rf node_modules/.cache dist && printf 'VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=%s\nVITE_NAVER_ENABLED=%s\n' "$VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID" "$VITE_NAVER_ENABLED" > .env && cat .env && VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID="$VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID" VITE_NAVER_ENABLED="$VITE_NAVER_ENABLED" npm run build && cd ../server && npm install

deploy.startCommand: npm run migrate --prefix server && node server/server.js
